remarks: Tucked away on one of East Manhattan Beach's most coveted non-through streets, 1515 5th Street pairs a private, quiet setting with easy access to everything the city has to offer. This Mediterranean residence sits on a generous 7,512-square-foot lot and offers approximately 4,130 square feet of living space, including five bedrooms, an office, and 4.5 bathrooms. The thoughtfully designed floor plan flows across multiple living and entertaining areas, filled with natural light and generously sized rooms.
